name: ID Shortcuts
description: Turns IDs written in comments, messages or descriptions into clickable shortcuts.

enabled.name: Enable ID shortcuts
enabled.description: Highlight IDs in comments, messages and descriptions. Turn off if you want to disable this without restarting the game.

id-target.name: Treat IDs as
id-target.description: Lets you decide whether the ID you clicked is for a level or a list, or always treat them as one of the two.

require-ctrl.name: Require Ctrl to open
require-ctrl.description: Only open the level when Ctrl (Cmd on macOS) is held while clicking. Off by default on mobile.

min-digits.name: Minimum digits
min-digits.description: How many digits a number needs for it to count as an ID.

debug-mode.name: Debug mode
debug-mode.description: Draws the clickable areas in red and writes detailed logs. The logs include the text being scanned, so leave this off unless you are diagnosing something.
